status: registered 2026-11-06 before any matched-config result or new test frame exists
purpose: Compare memory, analytical and learned guidance under one shared search configuration on trajectories never seen during method design

coupled.test_sampling: continuous uniform over the bounding box of existing user start positions and velocities; same physics, surface and segments (81)

specular.test_sampling: new receiver trajectories from the same scene and ray-tracing parameters as munich_specular_v3

excluded_from_claims: Existing pilot splits informed method design and are development data; they may be benchmarked for continuity only and never reported as the test result
scope_limit: Held-out trajectories in the same scene and surface, not a held-out environment. Simulation only. Spatial control only; temporal forecasting is out of scope for this comparison.
node: 3060-1; all reported timing comes from one node, one pinned core, single thread, with no concurrent job of ours

methods.uniform_ga: memory on; anchors and hops ranked uniformly at random; lesion control for whether ranking matters
methods.memory_ga: memory on; ranking = normalized analytical gain + 0.1 * per-bit std of remembered patterns; no neural network. An adaptation inspired by Zardi et al. 2024, not a reproduction
methods.analytical_ga: memory on; ranking = normalized analytical gain
methods.mlp_ga: memory on; ranking = analytical gain plus MLP policy
methods.attention_ga: memory on; ranking = analytical gain plus attention policy
methods.attention_no_physics_ga: as attention_ga with explicit physics features removed; analytical flip gains retained

shared_search_config.rule: Every GA variant runs the same step sequence and limits. Variants differ only in the ranking signal and whether memory is enabled. Neural overhead is paid from the same deadline.
shared_search_config.selection: Medium equals the values previously assigned to analytical_ga, fixed here without consulting any matched result
shared_search_config.sensitivity: Small and large run on validation only, to show whether conclusions depend on the configuration. They are not used to change the primary.

training: Fresh checkpoints for every seed on 3060-1 from train and validation only; epochs and architectures unchanged

metrics.worst_user_spectral_efficiency: mean minimum user rate in bit/s/Hz, full-evaluator recomputed

optimization_latency.complete_runtime: p95 elapsed ms, including preparation, features, inference, memory and evaluation
optimization_latency.time_to_target: first time within target_margin of the frame reference; median and p95; runs that never reach it count as not reached and the reached fraction is reported
optimization_latency.frame_reference: best rate found on that frame by any method and seed at any budget

computational_budget.evaluations: mean count of candidate configurations scored, same counting rule for all methods; neural inference is not an evaluation and is reported as time
computational_budget.evaluations_to_target: evaluations used when time_to_target is reached

metrics.deadline_misses: reported per method and budget; never excluded

statistics.interval: paired trajectory bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 8251, 95 percent
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the contrasts below, on the primary budget and rate metric, using bootstrap two-sided p-values
statistics.margin_basis: Largest rate change observed under mesh doubling in coupled_wire_v1 physics evidence; applied to both experiments
statistics.decision: Improved only if the corrected interval lies entirely above the margin; equivalent if entirely within plus or minus the margin; otherwise inconclusive
